purpose: Teach: タックル/浪人/飛鳥/ピカソ/ボンド/リンカーン/フットサル/ヤクルト

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、ラグビー部のタックル練習辛そうだったな
lines.en: Riku, you looked like you were really struggling during those rugby tackle drills.
lines.style: Light tease with genuine observation underneath. Casual, knowing tone. Quick pace. Slight upturn at the end—inviting response but not demanding it.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、浪人覚悟してるな、桜
lines.en: You're really preparing yourself for ronin life, aren't you, Sakura.
lines.style: Dry deflection with a small smile in the voice. Turning the observation back on her. Even delivery, slightly flat—not quite a question, more of a wry acknowledgment.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、社会で飛鳥時代勉強したろ?
lines.en: Riku, didn't you study the Asuka period in social studies?
lines.style: Genuine curiosity cutting through the banter. Slightly faster, more direct. Testing whether he'll actually engage or keep deflecting.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、美術でピカソの真似してたな、桜
lines.en: You were mimicking Picasso in art class the other day, weren't you, Sakura.
lines.style: Quiet amusement. Soft accusation—he noticed something small she probably thought no one saw. Slight smile in the delivery.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、ボンド映画全部観たろ?
lines.en: Riku, you've watched every Bond film, haven't you?
lines.style: Curiosity with a hint of challenge. Faster tempo. She's testing him again—waiting to see if he'll admit to something he actually cares about.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、社会でリンカーン習ったろ?桜
lines.en: You learned about Lincoln in social studies, didn't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Genuinely uncertain now. Slower pace. A real question, not deflection. Small hesitation—he's actually trying to match her openness.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、フットサルの大会出るんだろ?
lines.en: Riku, you're going to compete in the futsal tournament, aren't you?
lines.style: Lighter, almost hopeful. She's asking about something that matters. Quick but not rushed. Gentle curiosity.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、ヤクルトファンだったな、桜
lines.en: You're a Yakult Swallows fan, aren't you, Sakura.
lines.style: Close and warm now. Gentle certainty—he knows this small thing about her. Soft, almost tender delivery. No challenge left.
